pages.title: Candlebound Coven
pages.creator: ikonode
pages.description:
Candlebound Coven is a top-down survival game starring Mina, a witch's cat, on a journey through five Halloween dreams. Guide her around danger while magical rites attack automatically. Bells, candle wisps, frost halos and purifying chimes provide different effects as you steer rather than aim each attack yourself.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, or drag on the playfield with touch controls. When Mina levels up, choose one of three upgrade cards to develop her rites. Survive until a dream's timer finishes to open the next one. A fallen run allows one revival, giving you a limited opportunity to continue the same attempt.

pages.title: Spider Solitaire
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description:
Spider Solitaire asks you to remove all 104 cards by assembling complete runs from King down to Ace in a single suit. Finished sequences leave the tableau, opening space to organize the cards that remain. Choose one-suit, two-suit or four-suit play for different levels of difficulty.

The stock deals another card onto every tableau column, but you can only use it when each column already contains a card. Look for useful moves before dealing, since the new row changes the arrangement across the whole board. Keep building suited sequences until every card has been cleared.

pages.title: Mahjong connect tiles
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Mahjong connect tiles is a tile-matching puzzle where movement brings identical pieces together. Shift a tile or a group horizontally or vertically to line up a pair. Matching tiles disappear when they sit next to one another or share an unobstructed line.

The goal is to remove the entire board. Check which pieces are blocking a connection before moving a group, because clearing one pair can make another easier to reach. The puzzle combines recognizing identical symbols with rearranging the tiles to create a clear connection.

pages.title: Obby Pinata Party
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Obby Pinata Party sends an Obby character out to battle piñatas and collect their coins. Choose a weapon, break into the piñatas' rewards and use your earnings to improve the equipment you carry. Exploration gives you more of the world to visit as you keep collecting.

Play with the mouse or touch controls. The upgrade loop links the coins from each piñata to the weapons you use against the next ones, giving you a reason to keep gathering money and trying the available equipment.

pages.title: Otu
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Otu is an orbital survival game in which you guide a triangle around a central platform. Rotate with A and D or the Left and Right arrows to avoid incoming spheres, closing bars and rotating lasers. Touching an obstacle ends the run.

Every ten seconds, an alert announces a random debuff. Effects such as inverted controls, a shifting orbit or a shaking screen change how you need to respond to the next hazard. Survive longer to earn more coins, then use them to customize the triangle. Watch both the obstacles and the latest debuff as you try to extend your time in orbit.

pages.title: Slingshot Chicken
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Slingshot Chicken is a physics-based demolition game about clearing pigs from unstable towers. Drag to aim the slingshot and release to launch a chicken at the structure. You have a limited supply of shots, so each attempt needs to help remove the pigs still standing.

TNT adds opportunities for explosive chain reactions, while collapsing supports can bring down more of a tower than a direct hit alone. Consider where a shot will affect the structure before launching. Clear every pig to complete the level and continue to another arrangement of towers and targets.

pages.title: Escape School Duel
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description:
Escape School Duel turns a dangerous school into an escape course. Get past traps, avoid the principal in the corridors and deal with teachers near the classrooms as you search for the way out. Play solo to improve your completion time or race a second player through the school.

Player one moves with WASD, jumps with Space and runs with Left Shift. Player two uses the arrow keys, L to jump and K to run. Press the jump control twice for a double jump. Learning the route helps you prepare for each hallway's hazards and keep moving toward the exit.

pages.title: Barry Prison Christmas Adventure
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Barry Prison Christmas Adventure is a Christmas-themed chase-and-hide game. Choose a scenario and take the role of either a hider trying to evade pursuit or a seeker looking for someone to catch. Your objective changes with the role you select.

As a hider, find a place to conceal yourself and keep away from pursuers. The chase option puts you on the other side of the search. Use the mouse or touch controls to play through the chosen scenario and respond to the characters around you.

pages.title: My horse is amazing
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
My horse is amazing combines obstacle riding with upgrades and boss battles. Guide your horse past fences, pits and water hazards, timing jumps to clear the route. Collect power-ups that strengthen its attack and health as you continue through the run.

Hold the left mouse button and move to steer left or right, or swipe with touch controls. Improvements make the horse faster and stronger, preparing it for the boss waiting at the end of a level. The challenge connects getting through the obstacles with developing a steed capable of handling that final encounter.

pages.title: Wood Blocks Jam
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Wood Blocks Jam is a sliding puzzle about sending colored wooden blocks into matching gates. Click and hold to grab a block, then drag it toward the gate in the same color. Clear every block from the board to solve the arrangement.

There is no time limit, so you can examine the routes before moving. Later puzzles introduce additional obstacles and mechanics that change which block can leave next. Make space for the pieces still waiting, and consider whether removing one block opens a useful path for another.

pages.title: Run Friends
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description:
Run Friends follows a group of heroines trying to rescue creatures on planets threatened by Vegapunk. Run through the adventure and save the Friends living on each endangered world, carrying the rescue effort from one planet to the next.

Use the directional keys and Enter, or the mouse, to operate the game. The creatures you are helping provide the purpose of the journey, with each planet adding another part of the mission to protect its inhabitants.

pages.title: Brainrot Merge
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Brainrot Merge is a physics-based dropping puzzle filled with unusual creatures. Drag left or right to choose where a creature will fall, then release it into the play area. When two identical creatures touch, they merge into a new form.

You can drop characters including Chimpanzini-Bananini and Tun-Tun-Tun Sahur. Watch how the pieces bounce and roll as you line up the next matching pair. Higher forms award more points, giving you a reason to keep developing the evolution chain rather than simply filling the space with new drops.

pages.title: Children's doctor: treating ears
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Children's doctor: treating ears puts you in a children's clinic with patients who need attention to their ears. Choose the supplied instruments and use them as directed by the game's on-screen prompts. The activities focus on selecting and controlling tools within a guided doctor scene.

Use the mouse on a computer or tap with touch controls. Follow the prompts for the selected instrument, complete the current interaction and move through the patient's care sequence.

pages.title: Sprunki Beats
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Sprunki Beats turns the characters into a rhythm challenge across four levels. Follow the beats and use clicks or taps to keep up with the music. Try both the normal and horror-themed modes as you explore the different environments.

pages.title: SWAT & Plants vs Zombies
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
SWAT & Plants vs Zombies combines armed squad members and plants in a tower-defense battle against advancing zombies. Drag units onto the battlefield, arrange the team and improve its strength through upgrades and new unlocks. Each SWAT member carries different weaponry, giving placement and squad selection a role in the defense.

Plants have cooldowns, so their powers need to be considered alongside the soldiers' attacks. Try to limit losses: keeping more of the team intact increases the reward for completing a level. Use the mouse or touch controls to position the units and develop the combined defense against each wave.

pages.title: Solitaire Tail
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description:
Solitaire Tail pairs card solitaire with a dragon-raising theme. Move every card onto the foundations, building each suit upward. On the tableau, arrange cards downward in alternating colors to uncover more of the layout and create useful moves.

Only a King can begin an empty column. When the tableau offers no suitable move, draw from the stock and look for a card you can place on a foundation or an existing column. Tap or drag to move the cards, working through the deal until the entire layout has reached the foundations.

pages.title: Hyper Cars Ramp Crash
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description:
Hyper Cars Ramp Crash is a stunt-driving game with seven sports cars and several ways to put them through crashes and jumps. Choose open-world driving, stunt challenges or Fall mode, then play alone or share the game with a second player.

In solo play, drive with WASD or the arrow keys, use Left Shift for nitro, R to reset the car and C to change the camera. For two players, the first keeps the WASD controls while the second uses the arrow keys, N for nitro, L to reset and U for the camera. The different modes give the cars different settings for trying stunts and testing their landings.

pages.title: Fish Feeding
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description:
Fish Feeding puts a small fish in waters patrolled by hungry sharks. Keep the fish away from those predators and try to build a higher score. A click or tap reverses the direction of rotation, giving you a way to change its movement when danger approaches.

Watch where the sharks are heading before reversing. The challenge is choosing the moment that keeps your fish clear of them while the attempt continues. Stay alive long enough to push the score beyond your previous result.

pages.title: Police Car Line Driving
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description:
Police Car Line Driving is an arcade pursuit game about keeping a police car moving through a hazardous road. Chase unauthorized vehicles, avoid bombs and other traffic, and try to cover more distance for a higher score. Pursued vehicles add to your points, while a collision ends the attempt.

Tap and swipe to move the police car. Watch the next obstacle before changing your position, especially when another vehicle and a bomb limit the available space. The results screen shows the current score and your best, giving you a target for a fresh run.

pages.title: Makeup Stack
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Makeup Stack takes cosmetic tasks onto a course with different doors to choose between. Pass through the gates you want to use and work toward applying makeup for the waiting customers. The objective is to complete the task and make up more people as you continue.

Tap to begin, then pay attention to the choices along the route. Your path through the doors forms part of preparing the makeup that reaches the customers, linking the course decisions with the finished service at the end.

pages.title: Moto Stunts Driving & Racing
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description:
Moto Stunts Driving & Racing is a side-scrolling motorcycle game with Racing and Level modes. Guide a cartoon rider over the platform tracks and reach the finish quickly while keeping the rider alive. Balancing progress with the dangers of the route is part of every attempt.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to move. Earn coins and put them toward another motorcycle as you work on better times and rewards. The initial bike can carry you through the challenges, while buying other motorcycles gives you more options for chasing a stronger result.

pages.title: Football Superstars 2024
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Football Superstars 2024 lets you choose an international team for a friendly match or a tournament run. Friendly mode allows you to select both your own side and the opponent, making it a way to try different matchups before committing to a competition.

In World tournament mode, choose one team and try to beat the opponents selected for you on the way to winning trophies. Seven international teams are available. The two modes separate a single chosen fixture from the challenge of leading the same side through a tournament.

pages.title: Christmas Collect
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Christmas Collect is a chain-matching game about gathering target Christmas items before time runs out. Press an item and trace through identical neighboring pieces, linking horizontally, vertically or diagonally. Release after selecting at least three to collect the group.

Longer chains provide bonuses, including extra time for a link of more than seven items. Check the level's requested objects before starting another chain so the match helps complete the collection goal. If the timer expires before you have gathered the required items, the level is lost.

pages.title: Turkey Twist Tetriz
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Turkey Twist Tetriz combines rotating pieces with Thanksgiving-themed matching. Position the festive items to make matches and build your score while keeping the board from overflowing. Each placement changes the space available for the pieces that follow.

Use the mouse to play and consider the rotation before committing to a position. Look for a placement that helps form a match without leaving the board too crowded. The challenge is balancing immediate points with enough room to keep the game going.

pages.title: Night Neon Racers
pages.creator: haiykut
pages.description:
Night Neon Racers is a driving game with racing, drifting and vehicle-destruction modes. Compete against other cars, build up drifts or take on traffic in the car-blasting mode. Those activities earn diamonds as you try the available sports cars and challenges.

Drive with WASD or the arrow keys. Left Shift activates nitro and R respawns the car. Choose the mode that matches the driving task you want to tackle, then adjust your approach to its objective, from getting ahead of a rival to sustaining a drift or destroying another vehicle.

pages.title: Spot the Difference
pages.creator: Dumadu Games Pvt Ltd
pages.description:
Spot the Difference presents two illustrated pictures with details that do not quite match. Compare the scenes and tap the object or area that differs. The pictures include homes, landscapes and outdoor settings, giving you different designs to examine across the levels.

Look at one part of each image in turn, comparing the same location before moving to the next section. Your task is to identify the changed details rather than simply select objects that appear in both pictures. Keep checking the scenes until you have found their differences.

pages.title: Giant Wanted
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description:
Giant Wanted casts you as a sniper defending home from invading giants. Aim your weapon at the attackers and shoot to stop them from taking over. Slide to adjust the aim, then release to fire.

The game puts the approaching giants at the center of each encounter, with guns providing your means of fighting back. Judge the target before releasing the shot and continue dealing with the enemies threatening the area. The overall objective is to defeat the giants and protect the world from their invasion.

pages.title: Winter Holiday Puzzles
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Winter Holiday Puzzles offers jigsaw scenes built around snowy landscapes, snowmen and winter celebrations. Choose a picture and put its pieces back together to recreate the complete scene. Use the mouse to work on the puzzle.

Compare the shapes and picture details as you arrange the pieces, looking for parts that belong to the same section of the image. The collection keeps its focus on winter, giving you another snow-covered scene to assemble when you want a different picture.

pages.title: Extreme Motorcycle Simulator
pages.creator: Inspector Studios
pages.description:
Extreme Motorcycle Simulator gives you a motorcycle and tasks to complete around a large city. Ride through the urban setting, travel toward the assignments and use the bike as your way to explore the roads between them.

Control the motorcycle with the arrow keys. Shift raises the front of the bike, adding another riding action alongside traveling through the city. Follow the tasks waiting in the environment and work on controlling your motorcycle as you move from one part of the city to another.

pages.title: Police Real Chase Car Simulator
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description:
Police Real Chase Car Simulator puts a police car into an open city with missions, traffic and opportunities for stunts. Drive between the buildings, follow the available assignments and keep control of the car while traveling through normal road traffic.

WASD controls driving, C changes the camera and R resets the car. Use M for the map, Z for missions and H for the siren; F lets you enter or leave the vehicle. The city gives you routes to explore between tasks, with driving and stunt handling forming part of completing the assignments.

pages.title: City of Billiards
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description:
City of Billiards sets up pool-shot challenges in different parts of a city. Adjust the cue's direction, angle and power, then choose where to strike the ball to refine the shot. Each arrangement asks you to complete its billiards challenge within a limited number of hits.

Use the mouse to set up your attempt and account for the positions of the other balls. The twenty levels become harder as you progress, changing the layout you need to solve. Consider the intended path before using another hit, since reaching the level's limit leaves less room to correct a poor shot.

pages.title: Circus Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: Baby Daisy Games
pages.description:
Circus Jigsaw Puzzle gives you six circus pictures featuring animals and clowns. Choose an image and a puzzle mode, then drag its pieces into place to rebuild the scene. Use the mouse to arrange the scattered parts.

Look for matching edges and sections of the same character or background as you assemble the picture. The different images let you move between circus scenes, while choosing a mode changes the puzzle you take on. Completing the arrangement restores the full illustration.

pages.title: Hearts Popping
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Hearts Popping is a fidget-popper game where the sparkling heart identifies the bubble to press. Pop the current target quickly to earn more points, then keep following the hearts until the level's bubbles are cleared.

Timing and selection both affect your score. Missing a heart while it sparkles costs fifty points, and pressing a wrong bubble costs one hundred. Watch for the next sparkle rather than pressing every bubble in sight, keeping the score penalties in mind as you clear the popper.

pages.title: Monsters TD
pages.creator: Booblyc OU
pages.description: Monsters TD puts you in charge of defending a portal into the human world. Monsters are approaching, and your task is to hold them back before they can break through. Protecting the portal gives the tower-defense battle its central objective as you confront the invading creatures.

pages.title: Mazes
pages.creator: Dumadu Games Pvt Ltd
pages.description: Mazes is a labyrinth puzzle about guiding a dot to the escape route. Study the passages, choose a direction and work your way through the maze toward the way out. Different levels give you new arrangements to navigate, with the route through the walls forming the central challenge.

pages.title: Airport Rush
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description:
Airport Rush makes you responsible for aircraft arriving at and departing from an airport. Manage the landings and takeoffs so each plane can complete its journey safely. Your decisions need to keep both sides of the airport's traffic operating.

Watch the aircraft waiting for attention and coordinate their movements as you run the airport. The challenge is handling those arrival and departure demands together, keeping track of which planes still need permission to continue.

pages.title: Among Them Space Run
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Among Them Space Run is a survival arcade game starring a crewmate in space. Keep the character within the play area for as long as possible and gather the space collectibles needed for the journey home. The top and bottom of the stage are boundaries to avoid.

Watch the character's position while pursuing another pickup. Staying safely on the screen remains the priority, even when a collectible draws you toward an edge. Continue the run and collect what you can as you work toward helping the crewmates return home.

pages.title: Face Paint Salon
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description:
Face Paint Salon lets you create decorative designs directly on a character's face. Make a party doodle from scratch or work with the available themes, choosing how the painted picture will look. The painted artwork forms the character's party look.

Try a different design or theme when you want another style of face decoration. Combine the elements into your own picture and use the face as the canvas for a finished party look.

pages.title: Kart Rush
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description:
Kart Rush is a cartoon kart-racing game with ramps, obstacles and speed boosts. Drive onto ramps to perform stunts, and use the yellow arrows on the ground or ramps to accelerate. The route also contains obstacles you need to avoid while keeping the kart moving.

Look ahead before taking a ramp so you can account for the section that follows the stunt. Boosts help you pick up speed, but your path still needs to stay clear of hazards as you continue the race.

pages.title: Impossible Truck Driving Stunt Track Parking
pages.creator: Mind Games
pages.description: Impossible Truck Driving Stunt Track Parking focuses on driving and parking a truck. Work through the vehicle-handling challenges and position the truck carefully for the parking task. The game puts control of a large vehicle at the center of its driving practice.

pages.title: Crazy Traffic Car Racing Game
pages.creator: Mind Games
pages.description:
Crazy Traffic Car Racing Game takes its racing onto highways and city roads shared with traffic. Overtake other vehicles and compete with rival drivers while making your way through the road environment. Different racing modes offer further ways to take part.

Watch for space before attempting an overtake, keeping the traffic around your car in mind as well as the racer ahead. The game combines the competition with navigating a road that still has other vehicles using it.

pages.title: Funny Match Card
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Funny Match Card asks you to remember pictures hidden behind cards. Turn over two at a time and look for identical partners. Use the images already revealed to find the remaining pairs with fewer unnecessary guesses.

pages.title: Motor Bike Stunts Sky 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description:
Motor Bike Stunts Sky 2020 puts a motorcycle on elevated stunt courses. Ride along the track and get past each level's traps to reach the finish. The challenge is keeping the bike on course while dealing with the obstacles built into the route.

Look at the next section before approaching a trap and adjust your ride to the space available. Each completed level brings another sky-track arrangement to work through on the motorcycle.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Eye Care
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description:
Baby Hazel Eye Care follows Hazel to an eye clinic after she develops an eye infection. Stay with her during the checkup, respond to what she needs and help her follow the specialist's instructions. The activities take place around the examination and Hazel's care at the clinic.

Pay attention to the requests in each scene as you assist the doctor and comfort Hazel. Working through those interactions carries the visit forward, with the focus on helping the character during her eye-care appointment.

pages.title: Color Flows
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Color Flows is a flood-coloring puzzle where the whole board must become one color within twenty-two moves. Choose a color to bring neighboring tiles into the growing main region, then repeat until the remaining colors have been absorbed.

Look at the edges of your current region before choosing. A useful color reaches more of the surrounding board and leaves connections for the next move. Keep track of the move allowance as you plan a sequence that can cover every tile.

pages.title: Oil Tanker Transporter Truck
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description:
Oil Tanker Transporter Truck puts you in charge of a tanker carrying cargo to its destination. Load up and drive the transport vehicle along off-road delivery routes, working through the missions by bringing the cargo where it is needed.

Keep the size of the truck in mind as you approach the next section of road. The delivery objective connects handling the tanker with reaching the required destination, giving each journey a transport task to complete.

pages.title: Face Paint Party
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description:
Face Paint Party begins with preparations for an evening of painted faces and matching fashion. Start with the game's spa facial activities, then create a face-paint design to wear to the party. Choose an outfit that works with the colors and pattern you have made.

The makeover connects three parts of the preparation: the facial scene, the painted artwork and the clothing. Consider the face design when selecting the outfit so the finished party look brings those choices together.

pages.title: Happy Animals Memory Game
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Happy Animals Memory Game is a card-matching puzzle featuring animal pictures. Choose a game mode and find two cards showing the same animal. Use the mouse to select cards, or tap them with touch controls.

Remember which animal appears in each position as you work through the board. A picture that does not match the current selection can help you locate a later pair. Continue identifying the matching animals until you have dealt with the full arrangement.

pages.title: Lets Invite Santa
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description:
Lets Invite Santa follows Princess Mia as she gets ready to welcome Santa for Christmas. Help choose her festive outfit, then take part in decorating a snowman and a cake for the celebration. The preparations cover both Mia's appearance and the decorations around the occasion.

Work through the dress-up and decorating activities to bring the Christmas scene together. Coordinate the clothing you choose for Mia, then turn to the snowman and cake to finish the items she wants ready before the visit.

pages.title: GEOMETRY DASH BLACKBOARD
pages.creator: y9-games.com
pages.description:
GEOMETRY DASH BLACKBOARD sends a square character through courses drawn with bright lines and shapes on a blackboard. Reach the exit gate without hitting the blocks along the way. Passing above or below the obstacles is essential, since a collision fails the attempt.

You can choose how fast the game moves. Use that choice to approach a level at a pace you can manage, then concentrate on the gaps between the blocks. Clear the route to the gate and continue through the available levels with the square character you have selected.

pages.title: Dunk Jump
pages.creator: GameNing
pages.description: Dunk Jump sends a ball between walls lined with spikes. Time each jump to reach a safe section and collect stars along the way. Spend the stars on other balls while trying to extend the run without a collision.

pages.title: Xmas Jigsaw Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Xmas Jigsaw Deluxe offers Christmas pictures in two puzzle sizes. Easy mode uses twenty-four pieces, while Hard mode divides the picture into forty-eight. Take the pieces from the panel on the left and drop them onto the board to rebuild the scene.

Start with recognizable corners or edges when they help you establish the outline, then use the picture details to place the remaining pieces. Finishing an image completes its level. Work through the full collection of pictures to finish the game's Christmas jigsaw challenge.

pages.title: FPS Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: FPS Simulator is a first-person shooting game featuring computer-controlled enemies and a selection of weapons. Use the available armaments to take on the enemy bots, choosing which weapon you want to bring into the confrontation. The focus is on armed combat against those opponents.

pages.title: Space Combat Sim
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Space Combat Sim puts a spacecraft under your control for space battles. Adjust the throttle, boost and roll to maneuver, then fire with the mouse buttons. Choose one of the three modes and keep the craft in position to attack opposing forces.

pages.title: Live Aqua Hero Adventure
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description:
Live Aqua Hero Adventure casts you as a hero fighting monsters in an underwater setting. Move through the environment and confront the creatures threatening it, using both movement on land and swimming as part of the adventure.

WASD moves the hero, Space jumps, Shift increases movement speed and F controls swimming. Switch your attention between the route through the area and the monsters you are there to fight, using the movement actions to continue the hero's mission beneath the water.

pages.title: Mexican Master Chef
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description:
Mexican Master Chef brings several street-food stalls together in a cooking game set at a carnival food festival. Try the activities around fries, hotdogs, pizza, burgers, noodles and churros, preparing food from the different stalls.

The choice of dishes gives you more than one type of food to work on during the festival. Move between the cooking activities and explore the selection, from savory snacks to the churros stall. The game centers on taking the chef's role across this collection of street-food venues.

pages.title: Jelly Match3
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Jelly Match3 is a matching puzzle about bringing together at least three jellies of the same type. Look for pieces that belong in the same group and make the required matches across the playfield. Recognizing the jelly types helps you decide which combination to work on next.

pages.title: Swat vs Zombies 2
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description:
Swat vs Zombies 2 puts a lone SWAT officer among zombies with survival as the objective. Fight the undead around you and keep the officer alive through the confrontation. The weapon shop offers additional equipment to buy for the battles.

Choose from the available weapons as you continue the fight, using the shop to change the equipment you rely on. The central task stays with the officer: deal with the zombies surrounding him and survive their threat.

pages.title: Origin Fashion Fair
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description:
Origin Fashion Fair follows Mia, Emma and Ella as they prepare for a fashion contest. Begin by helping the girls shop for the clothing they need, then use those selections to dress them for the fair. Each participant needs a finished outfit for the event.

Consider the look you want to build while choosing the clothes, then put the pieces together in the dress-up stage. The game connects finding the outfits with styling the three girls before they take part in the competition.

pages.title: Hit the Hole
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Hit the Hole is a mouse-controlled target challenge about guiding a playing piece into a hole. Adjust its movement to bring it onto the goal. Complete the current arrangement to continue to the next level.

pages.title: Classic Car Parking Driving School
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Classic Car Parking Driving School is a driving-and-parking game focused on handling a classic car. Work on positioning the vehicle for the parking task and controlling its approach to the space. The challenge centers on maneuvering and placement as you take part in the game's parking practice.

pages.title: Farm Animals Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Farm Animals Puzzle Challenge turns pictures of farm animals into jigsaws. Choose a difficulty, then arrange the separated pieces to restore the complete image. The animal subjects include cows, horses, pigs, goats, dogs and sheep.

Look at both the edges of a piece and the part of the animal shown on it as you decide where it fits. The difficulty choices let you pick the puzzle challenge before entering the play screen, giving you different ways to work through the farm-picture collection.

pages.title: Angel or Demon Avatar Dress Up Game
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description:
Angel or Demon Avatar Dress Up Game lets you design an anime-style girl with an angel or demon theme. Choose the character's appearance and combine the customization options into the original character you want to create. You can build a gentle angel look or take the design toward a darker demon style.

When the character is ready, save the result in either full-body or avatar form. The two output options let you keep the whole design or focus on its portrait, giving the finished character a use beyond the styling screen.

pages.title: Car Tracks Unlimited
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Car Tracks Unlimited lets you drive different cars through a series of challenging road levels. Steer with WASD, watch the traffic and keep the vehicle on a useful route. Work through the courses while trying the available cars.

pages.title: Cotton Candy
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Cotton Candy turns making and decorating a sweet into a hands-on preparation game. Choose a shape or flavor, gather cotton candy onto the stick and add decorative details. Arrange the finishing touches to personalize the completed treat.

pages.title: Street Fighter Madness
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description:
Street Fighter Madness follows Luke Steel as he takes revenge on a rival group. Fight the opponents in each stage and keep Luke alive as the enemies become stronger. Wooden boxes may contain weapons, giving you something useful to look for during the confrontation.

Check those boxes when you need more ways to deal with the next opponent. The increasing enemy strength makes later stages more demanding, so use the equipment you find while working through Luke's fights. Survival and defeating the rival fighters are the goals of the journey.

pages.title: Basketball Fever
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description:
Basketball Fever challenges you to make as many baskets as you can. Take your shots toward the hoop and keep adding successful baskets while working toward a better performance on the court. Coins provide a separate collection goal alongside the shooting.

Use the coins you gather to unlock additional balls. That progression gives you another reason to continue taking shots, as you work on your basket total and expand the selection of balls available for play.

pages.title: Dinosaurs fix the Patch
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Dinosaurs fix the Patch is a dinosaur-assembly puzzle with ten levels to complete. Fit the separated parts into the dinosaur and work toward restoring the whole creature. Each stage gives you another assembly task to solve as you progress through the collection.

pages.title: Rocket Rodent Nightmare
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Rocket Rodent Nightmare is a timing game about propelling a character through narrow openings in walls. Choose the moment to move so the rodent passes through the gap without making contact. Touching a wall ends the attempt.

Every obstacle you pass adds one point. Watch the next opening as you prepare another movement, keeping the small clearance in mind before committing. The aim is to keep traveling farther through the walls and turn a longer run into a higher score.

pages.title: Highway Motorcycle
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Highway Motorcycle puts a motorbike on roads filled with other vehicles. Steer around the traffic, watch your speed and keep an eye on the remaining time and health. Continue through checkpoints while trying to extend the ride.

pages.title: Ice Princess In NYC
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Ice Princess in NYC helps Elsa choose a look for her trip to New York. Browse dresses, separate clothing pieces, hairstyles and headwear. Coordinate the available options to give the visiting princess a finished city outfit.

pages.title: 60 Second Whack
pages.creator: Joshua Hall
pages.description:
60 Second Whack gives you one minute to hit as many moles as possible. Keep responding to the targets while trying to stay alive through the round. Healing items and bombs provide extra help as you work toward a higher whack total.

Watch for another mole while considering when to use those aids. The countdown limits how much time you have to add hits, while survival matters if you want to make use of the full sixty seconds. Try to finish with a whack count you can improve on the next attempt.

pages.title: London Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
London Jigsaw Puzzle turns famous London landmarks into pictures to assemble. Rebuild scenes featuring places such as Big Ben, the London Eye, Buckingham Palace and the Tower of London, fitting the pieces together until the image is complete.

You can change the number of pieces across the rows or columns to adjust the puzzle. Hints, zoom controls and a choice of working backgrounds provide further ways to set up the board. Choose a landmark and a piece arrangement, then compare the shapes and image details as you restore the view.

pages.title: Words Search Hollywood Search
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Words Search Hollywood Search is a timed word-finding game. Look through the letters for the words you need, then mark the ones you discover before the countdown expires. Later stages increase the number of words waiting to be found.

Check the letters around a likely word and follow its sequence before selecting it. As the target list grows, keeping track of words already found helps you focus on the ones still missing. Complete the search within the available time to continue the challenge.

pages.title: My Pretty Doll Dress Up
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
My Pretty Doll Dress Up puts you in the stylist's role with dolls as your models. Choose clothing and accessories from the wardrobe, then combine them into the outfit you want each doll to wear. The fashion choices are the main activity of the game.

Try different pieces together and look at the result as a complete outfit. Accessories give you a way to finish the clothing combination, letting you develop a different look whenever you want to change the model's style.

pages.title: Hand Aimer
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description:
Hand Aimer is a physics-based aiming game in which a ball must hit a target. Set up your attempt and use ricochets to send the ball along the route you want. Successful hits build your score.

Consider how a rebound will change the ball's direction before committing to the shot. A useful angle can turn a bounce into part of the route toward the target, making the way the ball travels as important as the initial aim.

pages.title: Watermelon : Unlimited Puzzle
pages.creator: Noobzilla
pages.description: Watermelon : Unlimited Puzzle is a fruit puzzle about rearranging the pieces into a complete watermelon. Swap to move the parts and work out which arrangement restores the whole fruit.

pages.title: Pool Diving Extreme
pages.creator: Pupgam Studios
pages.description:
Pool Diving Extreme challenges you to land in a swimming pool after jumping from a balcony. Start from lower heights and work toward jumps from higher floors, with the penthouse providing a farther goal above the pool.

Objects such as loungers, sunshades and floats can provide an extra impulse during the attempt. Use those interactions as part of reaching the water, judging how the next jump will carry the character toward the pool below. The objective remains getting into the swimming pool as the starting height increases.

pages.title: Black Gold Plumber
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Black Gold Plumber is an oil-routing puzzle set around extracting petroleum from Texas. Create a route that lets the oil reach the surface, working out how the available path needs to connect. The game contains one hundred levels with increasing difficulty.

Study the route between the oil and its destination before changing the arrangement. Each level gives you another connection problem to solve, with the extraction theme tying the puzzles together. Your aim is to bring the petroleum upward through a completed path.

pages.title: Royal Rush
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Royal Rush is an endless runner with coins and upgrades at the center of its progression. Collect money during the run, then buy improvements and return to try to gather more. The goal is to increase the amount of treasure you can collect across your attempts.

pages.title: Blue Mahjong HD
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description:
Blue Mahjong HD is a tile-solitaire game with fruit, classic and modern themes. Choose from six layouts and remove identical pairs of open tiles. Clearing a pair exposes more of the arrangement, giving you further matches to look for underneath.

The goal is to remove all the tiles, but a game also ends when no exposed matching pairs remain. Check which pair will open a useful section before selecting it, especially when several copies of the same tile are visible. The layouts offer different levels of difficulty within the same matching rules.

pages.title: Real Doll Creator
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
Real Doll Creator lets you create dolls and then dress them for different occasions. Build the character first, then choose clothing for a day at school, a walk around the city or a trip to the park. Each setting gives you another outfit to put together.

Use the wardrobe to style the doll for the occasion you have selected. The game combines making the model with dressing it afterward, so the finished look reflects both the character you created and the clothing choices around it.

pages.title: Ice Queen Skin Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Ice Queen Skin Doctor follows the Ice Queen through a facial-care appointment after springtime allergies affect her skin. Use the game's supplied tools to address the spots, swelling and rashes shown on the character's face, working through the activities in the treatment sequence.

Different tools are assigned to different tasks, including the game's laser and trimmer instruments. Follow each stage of the illustrated appointment and complete the interactions needed to finish the Queen's makeover. The focus is on carrying out the character-care tasks presented within the game.

pages.title: Ice O Matik
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Ice O Matik puts a robot to work in an ice-cream parlor. Help it scoop the ice cream and serve the finished treats. The game centers on assisting this mechanical server with the parlor's ice-cream service.

pages.title: Ben and Kitty Love Story
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
Ben and Kitty Love Story is a wedding dress-up game about preparing the couple for their ceremony. Choose Kitty's wedding dress, then match it with shoes and a flower bouquet. Her finished look forms the first part of the preparations.

Next, put together Ben's outfit using a suit, shoes and a choice of tie or bow tie. Consider both characters' clothing as you style the couple for the same occasion. The goal is to have Ben and Kitty ready for the wedding in the outfits you have selected.
